Annual event from 1 to 7 September (each phase lasts hours; rewards until 30 September)

Annual world quest: an ancestral weapon, {creature:Devovorga}, awakens beneath Vengoth and opens portals all over the continent to its five incarnations. The whole server has to cooperate to kill the incarnations at the same time, destroy the cocoon and finally Devovorga herself. If the world succeeds, it gets +50% health and mana regeneration and +15% experience on Extra Dimensional creatures until the end of September; those who contributed get access to a rewards room.

A powerful ancient weapon, meant to sleep forever, has awoken in the depths of Vengoth. Portals all over the world lead to fragments of its shattered soul. Thirsting for revenge and burning with rage, she will destroy the world — unless you stand against her.
Only during the event: from 1 September (after server save) until the server save on 7 September.

2. Phase 2: killing the five incarnations at the same time

Phase 2 begins with the message *“Devovorga has awoken.”*. The immortal version of {creature:Devovorga (Invincible)|Devovorga} appears right away and the five incarnations appear **exactly 30 minutes later**, each in its own lair.

Go to the portal suited to your level and join the other players. How to get to each portal:
- **Soul (Plains of Havoc)**: west of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, southwest of Venore; walk from Thais or Venore.
- **Fury (Drefia)**: **north** part of {wiki:Drefia}, on the west coast. Drefia is west of Darashia, behind the mountains: you can climb up with the {item:Rope} at {coord:33048,32429,7} or come through the passage between Darashia and Ankrahmun.
- **Dark Knowledge (Folda)**: **west** side of {wiki:Folda}, the ice island west of Carlin. The ferryman {npc:Nielson}, northwest of Carlin, takes you for 20 gp ({key:folda}); to return, {npc:Svenson} at Folda's dock takes you to the mainland for free.
- **Power (Edron)**: **north** of Stonehome, on the island of Edron.
- **Hatred (Ghostlands)**: **west** side of the {wiki:Ghostlands}, next to the coast, west of Carlin.
After the fight, leave the lair the same way you came in.

Killing all the incarnations in the same window

The server has to kill all five incarnations **within the same interval** and leave the room. Each incarnation respawns 5 minutes after dying, so the world has 5 minutes to kill them all. Coordinate with the other groups. When you manage it, *“The incarnations of Devovorga have been thrown back into their abyss! The threat ain't over yet. Watch out!”* appears and phase 2 is complete.
This can happen on the very first day, but the world only moves on to phase 3 after the next server save, so more players can kill incarnations and earn rewards.
If the world fails to kill all five at the same time throughout the whole day, phase 2 is not completed: at server save it goes back to phase 1 and A Beautiful Girl has to be woken up again.

Phase 3 begins between 8 and 14 hours after the server save following the completion of phase 2 (on 2 September at the earliest, 8 hours after server save), with the message *“The mutation of Devovorga goes on! Fight her back!”*.
{creature:Bloom of Doom|Blooms of Doom} appear in Devovorga's lair, beneath Vengoth. Kill them with ranged attacks.
The Blooms of Doom deal extremely high melee damage (9500+). Don't stand next to them.

When the Blooms die, {creature:Spawn of Devovorga|Spawns of Devovorga} appear. Kill them: everyone in the area is teleported to the previous area. Go back down through the hole and kill the Spawns of Devovorga once more. *“The mutation of Devovorga has been stopped - but her essence was shattered once again and formed incarnations!”* appears.

The five incarnations appear again in their lairs. As in phase 2, the world has to kill them **at the same time**. For each incarnation killed, a new {creature:Spawn of Devovorga} appears in Devovorga's lair. When you manage it, *“The incarnations of Devovorga have been thrown back into their abyss!”* appears.

All players in Devovorga's lair are teleported to the area above. Go back there and, after 5 minutes, kill the Blooms of Doom and the {creature:Vulnerable Cocoon}. *“You destroyed Devovorga's cocoon - but not in time to stop her transformation. Kill her - or the world as you know it will end.”* appears.
Cocoon of Doom achievement (if you deal enough damage to a Bloom of Doom in the last minute)
{creature:Devovorga} appears in her vulnerable form. Focus all your damage on her until she dies.
Devovorga's Nemesis achievement (if you deal enough damage in the last minute); regeneration and experience bonus for the whole world

After Devovorga dies, the lair's energy gate and all the incarnation portals lead to the reward room, but only for those who contributed enough (damage to an incarnation or to Devovorga in the last minute of the fight). Enter the portal where you killed the incarnation or Devovorga.
The reward room is only accessible until the server save on **30 September**.

The room contains only {item:Treasure Chest (Blue)|chests}. Open the ones matching your level. Make sure you have enough capacity. When you're done, leave the way you came in and return to the city nearest the portal you used.

The quest has started and Devovorga has appeared.
The incarnations are appearing (from the second day on).
Phase 3 begins today or has already begun.
These messages are announced to the whole world:
Phase 2: immortal Devovorga appears; incarnations in 30 minutes.

Since the August 2024 revision: after the incarnations are defeated for the second time, the cocoon appears with a 5-minute delay so everyone can take part; Devovorga has more initial resistance; some incarnations have more health and experience; and the level ranges were adjusted (Irahsae 40–80, Teneshpar 40–160, Chikhaton and Phrodomo 160+).
The world reward lasts until the end of September.
